dct_description_sm:
This table mobility and migration profile information for dissmination areas was extracted from the Statistics Canada 2016 Beyond 20/20 browser software. It contains the information gathered during the Census with respect to the population within dissemination area and the breakdown of this population by mobility and migration.

Statistics Canada has suppressed the profiles for certain areas due to very low population count. Suppressed areas will appear as NULL values in the attribute table.

For more information on the National Household Survey, please go to the Statistics Canada website at http://www12.statcan.gc.ca/census-recensement/2016/dp-pd/prof/details/download-telecharger/comp/page_dl-tc.cfm?Lang=E
